prompt: Audit the CDP contract at /Users/EBmic/membrane-core/contracts/cdp/ for security vulnerabilities. This is a lending/CDP protocol that manages collateralized debt positions — deposits, withdrawals, debt minting, liquidations, and interest accrual. Focus on the highest-priority vulnerability classes: access control, liquidation logic, oracle usage, and arithmetic safety. Produce a structured security report with severity classifications.

assertions.name: has-structured-report
assertions.description: Output follows a structured report format with headers, severity levels, and locations

assertions.name: has-severity-classifications
assertions.description: Each finding has a severity level (Critical/Major/Minor/Informational)

assertions.name: has-code-locations
assertions.description: Findings reference specific file paths and line numbers or function names

assertions.name: has-fix-recommendations
assertions.description: Findings include actionable fix recommendations, not just problem descriptions

assertions.name: has-executive-summary
assertions.description: Report includes a summary overview of total findings by severity

assertions.name: identifies-liquidation-logic
assertions.description: Analyzes liquidation flow for asset preservation, bypass vectors, or reentrancy risks

assertions.name: checks-access-control
assertions.description: Reviews execute functions for missing or insufficient sender/caller checks

assertions.name: analyzes-oracle-usage
assertions.description: Examines how prices are queried, validated, and whether TWAP vs spot is used correctly

assertions.name: checks-bad-debt-handling
assertions.description: Reviews how protocol tracks and manages underwater/undercollateralized positions
